summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing for Auktionsbevakning. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed covering /api/sources (9 Swedish sources), /api/auctions POST (keyword + Klaravik URL, source detected, total_now = round(current_bid*(1+vat/100)+buyer_fee), bid_history ascending ending at current_bid), listing + ?source filter, GET by id + 404, /refresh (bid never decreases, recomputes total), /analyze (AI valuation populated with new_price_estimate, used_price_estimate, confidence, market_position, comparables, insight), /stats shape, DELETE + 404. Frontend: dashboard loads, stats cards render, 'Bevaka auktion' modal opens, URL/keyword tabs switch, adding by keyword creates a card, detail modal opens with Recharts bid-history chart, 'Kör AI-värdering' populates ai-price-estimate (nypris/begagnatpris/comparables/insight), refresh and VAT toggle work, source filter narrows list, delete removes a card. UI is Swedish and modern.

issues: Overlay 'Okänd källa' badge text in top-left has very low contrast against bright image background on some cards (hard to read).

critical_code_review_comments: valuation.py pins model string 'gpt-5.4' - works via Emergent proxy in current env; keep an eye on availability.
scraper.generate_bid_history uses random, so the exact first point can be <= start but overall list is non-decreasing (tests confirmed).
server.refresh_auction recomputes buyer_fee = 10% of current_bid even when nothing changed; that's fine but note it diverges from the originally scraped buyer_fee.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); switch to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
scraper._parse_price's regex may misread prices containing both '.' and ' '; current tests passed but worth hardening for real sites.
No rate limiting on /analyze; could be abused since app is open (no auth).
seed_data_creation: Playwright created 1 'TEST Playwright objekt' auction (deleted during delete test); 1 Klaravik-URL auction remains from backend test (real scrape fallback).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run with pytest in ~10s. All critical flows green. If re-running, the Klaravik scrape depends on the remote site; backend falls back to scraped=false which the tests tolerate. AI analyze returns real Emergent LLM data in ~5-10s.
